mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_message_consume_log (message_id, consumer_name, biz_key, status, retry_count, error_message, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{messageId}, #{consumerName}, #{bizKey}, 'PROCESSING', #{retryCount}, NULL, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.select: SELECT id, message_id, consumer_name, biz_key, status, retry_count, error_message, create_time, update_time FROM sys_message_consume_log WHERE message_id = #{messageId} AND consumer_name = #{consumerName}
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_message_consume_log SET status = 'SUCCEEDED', error_message = NULL, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE sys_message_consume_log SET status = 'FAILED', retry_count = retry_count + 1, error_message = #{error}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE sys_message_consume_log SET status = 'PROCESSING', update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status IN ('PROCESSING', 'FAILED')
UPDATE sys_message_consume_log SET status = 'DEAD_LETTER', error_message = #{error}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
